metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant was like ‘Wait, who even aimed?’ and I blinked twice
metadata.description:
Didn’t mean to shoot but the enemy just stood there.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies like it’s confused.
Click if your best plays are pure accident chaos!
